question.text: A man is walking towards a vertical pillar in a straight path at a uniform speed. At a certain point <math><mi>A</mi></math> on the path, he observes that the angle of elevation of the top of the pillar is <math><msup><mrow><mn>30</mn></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></mrow></msup><mo>.</mo></math> After walking for <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> minutes from <math><mi>A</mi></math> in the same direction, at a point <math><mi>B</mi></math>, he observes that the angle of elevation of the top of the pillar is <math><msup><mrow><mn>45</mn></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></mrow></msup><mo>.</mo></math> Then the time taken (in minutes) by him, to reach from <math><mi>B</mi></math> to the pillar, is (take <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>.73</mo></math>)

solution.text:
In ∆QPA: hx+y=tan⁡30o⇒3h=x+y…….(i)
In ∆QPB: hy=tan⁡45o⇒h=y…….(ii)
From (i) and (ii), we get,

3 y=x+y⇒y= x 3 −1
Given that the distance x  is covered in 5 3 +1 minutes
Hence, the distance x 3 −1  is covered in 53+13−1=52+3=18.65 minutes
